Type: octagonal geometric wall mirror
Use: decorating a wall, reflecting light; living room, bedroom, entryway, above a sofa or console
Style: modern, glam, industrial
Materials: black metal wire frame, gold accent joints, mirror glass
Colors: black, gold, silver mirror

Feel: bold, graphic, striking
Goes with: white or grey walls, brass accents, black metal; modern or glam rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Octagonal Metalwork Hanging Geometric Wall Mirror, 28 Inch Height, Black Finish
product.description: Equal parts decor and function, this mirror provides a sculptural focal point. The octagonal mirrored glass is framed by black iron latticework in geometric patterns. Gold accents add to a 3D effect that will enhance a transitional or modern room. 3.7"D x 28"W x 28"H Metal, glass, engineered wood backing Ready to hang, all hardware included
